name: with-razor-per-file-compile
body: Scanner.WithRazor calls RazorCompiler.Compile once per Razor file, so tag-helper descriptors are recomputed for every file, and a file whose Compile throws for a non-Razor reason (such as an unreadable file) is warned about on stderr and gets no File record at all. Upgrade to one batched Compile call with a per-file fallback if large Razor projects scan slowly, and emit a File record without declarations if such files must still appear in the graph.
